libraries.name: hud-registry
libraries.description: UI Kit HUD registry, layout diagnostics and localized view projection.

exports.name: createHudRegistry
exports.description: Pure registry: no DOM, no network; the clock ticks only while a timer badge is shown.

exports.name: HudChangedEvent
HudDeps
exports.description: Clock, layout, matching and diagnostic dependencies of the HUD registry.

exports.name: HudOpenedEvent
HudRegistry
exports.description: HUD registration, layout projection and event subscriptions.

exports.name: hudRegistryModule
exports.description: Container provider: UI Kit owns the registry; SDK modules only consume the contract. The layout lives in configs scope `ui.hud`: a new snapshot of it (also a new segment) re-reads every item, with or without the game facade `mod-hud`.

exports.name: hudRegistryView
exports.description: Translate the registry snapshot into the existing ManyPlay side icon component. `lang` picks the inline label of the layout (`label.values`); a label key goes through `text`.
declarations: export function hudRegistryView(registry: HudRegistry, slot: HudSlot, text: (key: string) => string = (key) => key, lang = 'en'): readonly HudViewItem[];

exports.name: MissingWindowRule
exports.description: A HUD or bottom-menu click that no `ui.windows` rule answers: the window never opens.
declarations: export interface MissingWindowRule { readonly key: string; readonly id: string }

exports.name: reportMissingWindowRule
exports.description: Explicit error (not silenced): console.error with the route key and the `ruleMissing` report.
declarations: export function reportMissingWindowRule(key: string, id: string, report?: (issue: MissingWindowRule) => void): void;
